description: This file contains instrumented UI tests for an Android TV application, verifying browsing and playback functionalities.

classes.name: BrowseAndPlayerInstrumentedTest
classes.description: Instrumentation test class for UI verification of the Android TV video player app, including browsing and media playback.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes intents and launches MainActivity before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Releases intents and closes the scenario after each test.

methods.name: browse_rendersMainContainer_andFocusIsSet
methods.description: Verifies that the main container is displayed and focusable.

methods.name: browse_clicksFirstItem_andLaunchesPlayerActivity
methods.description: Simulates a click on the main container and checks that PlayerActivity is launched.

methods.name: player_showsPlayerView_andHandlesDpadKeys
methods.description: Launches PlayerActivity directly, verifies the player view is displayed, and simulates DPAD key presses.
